QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Weapon Rental
QuestInfo.0: They say that a special event has been prepared to celebrate re-balancing of the Explorer class...
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra says that she will let you borrow an item so that you can experience using a stronger weapon to complement your more powerful skills. But before that, she wants you to prove your ability to wield a stronger weapon... Challenge yourself to Cassandra's test.\n\n#i4000364# #t4000364# #b#c4000364# / 100#k
QuestInfo.2: You borrowed a powerful weapon from Cassandra. The weapon is only good for 7 days, so obtain it again from Cassandra once the time has passed. Cassandra will be #brenting out weapons until July 27th#k.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. Have you heard the rumor? They say that the Explorers are being completely changed! It seems that the Explorers are evolving to become more powerful and comparable with the Cygnus Knights and the Heroes. Isn't that exciting news?
0.1: Well, I certainly need to do something to celebrate such an occasion! I've prepared a weapon rental event so that Explorers can use a stronger weapon to complement their more powerful skills! Would you like to experience for a week the full potential of your skills?

yes.0: Okay! Here, take this weapon...after you've proven your ability to wield such a powerful weapon!
yes.1: Go to the #bAlcadno Research Institute Lab - Area - C-2#k, defeat the #rRoids#k, and bring back #b100 #t4000364##k. Once you complete this task, I'll lend you a powerful weapon.

no.0: Hmm... I know it's only for a week, but aren't you curious about your potential? Talk to me again if you change your mind.

1.0: Oh, you're here! Great! I'll let you borrow the weapon I've prepared.

yes.0: For a week, you can use this weapon to test out how much stronger you've become! I am lending out weapons once a day so if the weapon disappears, just come see me again. I plan on renting out the weapons until #bJuly 27th#k so come by and rent as much as you want until then!

item.0: Hmm... It doesn't look like you've brought all the items I asked for. You just need to go to the #bAlcadno Research Institute Lab - Area - C-2#k, defeat some #rRoids#k, and bring back #b100 #t4000364#s#k. I know you can do it!
